retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, kitschy aesthetic featuring saturated primary colors against a stark white background, paired with thick, interlocking bubble typography and macabre pop-art elements.
triggerTerms: interlocking bubble lettering with thick red outlines
high-key studio photography with macabre props
excludeWhen: requesting dark, moody, or low-light horror

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark white studio environment featuring subjects in vibrant, saturated clothing (yellow, purple, pink) engaged in stylized, campy violence. The composition is anchored by a large, top-heavy typographic treatment in yellow with a thick red border, utilizing interlocking 70s-style bubble letters.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key white background vs. saturated primary color palette
Playful, rounded typography vs. macabre, violent subject matter
Horizontal subject orientation vs. vertical typographic dominance
Flat vector graphic text vs. dimensional studio photography
coreInvariants: Thick red stroke surrounding interlocking yellow bubble letters
High-saturation color palette (Yellow, Red, Purple, Pink)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two human subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, oriented horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized title text in the upper right quadrant acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold yellow title, moves down to the subject's face, follows the arm upward, and then scans the horizontal layout of the second subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the subjects, creating a clinical, high-key look.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation for all colored elements against a maximum-value white background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are shortened to maintain a compact block shape
The dot on the 'i' or similar flourishes are integrated into the main body of the letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, illustrative display type paired with a clean, lowercase geometric sans-serif for secondary information.

preserve: Interlocking nature of the display text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, 70s geometric feel
Captures the bulbous, interlocking potential of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph on a pure white background. Two subjects in bright yellow and purple-striped clothing are lying horizontally. Include stylized, bright red liquid splatters and campy props like a hammer. Ensure lighting is flat and bright.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, interlocking bubble lettering in the top right. The letters should be bright yellow with a very thick red outline. Below this, add a single line of small, black, lowercase geometric sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without shadows?
Is the main text yellow with a thick red border?
Are the letters in the main title interlocking?
Is the color palette limited to high-saturation primaries?

adjustableVariables: Specific props used for campy horror effect
Exact wording of the bubble text
mustRedesign: Any realistic or dark horror elements
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red outline on the text is thick and consistent.
Ensure the white background is blown out and featureless.
Verify that the subjects' clothing colors are vibrant and pop against the white.
Confirm the secondary text is small, black, and lowercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key white studio backdrop + Saturated primary color subjects + Interlocking 70s bubble lettering with thick contrast stroke.
